packet.title: Device CI (write here; the owner enables it)

body.p: After and 's scripts. Owns new .github/workflows/bindings.yml, disabled as asks (workflow_dispatch only) until the owner turns CI back on. The jobs:

item.p: Linux: the kotlin/jvm and swift/linux ctests;
Android: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner on an ubuntu runner with KVM, x86_64, API 24 and 35;
macOS: xcodebuild test on an iOS simulator, and swift test;
device farms (Firebase Test Lab for Android, a physical iOS device) as jobs that need secrets the owner adds.

body.p: The workflow is checked here with actionlint, if that can be fetched, and not run.
